clue.text: Directions sailor needed to clean deck

parts.note: S and W are the compass points south and west
AB, able seaman, is the usual crossword sailor

explanation.surface: A navy instruction: point the sailor in the right direction and set him scrubbing the deck.
explanation.definitionFit: To swab a ship's deck is to mop it clean, a nautical verb.

clue.text: A large and violent goddess that reacts with 6

parts.note: L is the standard abbreviation for large, as on clothing labels
Kali is the fierce Hindu goddess of destruction

explanation.surface: A big, ferocious deity who flares up on contact with something.
explanation.walkthrough: 6 is the answer to 6 down, ACID, so the definition is something that reacts with an acid.
explanation.definitionFit: Chemically, a base that neutralises acids in a reaction is the textbook partner of an acid.

clue.text: Means to connect scientist, as well as the writer, to listeners

indicators.note: to listeners means the words are judged by how they are heard, not spelt

parts.words: scientist, as well as the writer
parts.note: Robert Hooke was the seventeenth-century English physicist; as well as means and; the writer refers to the setter, giving I

explanation.surface: A matchmaking service linking a scientist, the author and an audience.
explanation.walkthrough: HOOKE, AND, I said aloud sound like the fastener, a small hook that catches in a loop.
explanation.definitionFit: A hook-and-eye fastening is a pair of metal pieces used to join two edges of a garment.

clue.text: Test material that shows up in final? It must

indicators.note: shows up in signals that the letters appear inside the run of words final it must

explanation.surface: A student hopes the test material will appear in the final exam.
explanation.definitionFit: Litmus paper is the indicator used in a simple acid-alkali test in chemistry lessons.

clue.text: Vivid colour of hair covering key person

indicators.note: covering signals that the hair word wraps around the key person word

parts.note: a shock is a thick bushy mass of hair
a kingpin is the most important person in a group

explanation.surface: A loud dye job: a bright shade of hair on the head of an important figure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'key' suggests a piano or a door, but key person is a single idea, the central figure.
explanation.definitionFit: Shocking pink is a brilliant, intense shade of pink popularised by Schiaparelli.

clue.text: Something helpful containing cold, so-called drug

indicators.note: containing signals that the helpful word holds the letter for cold

parts.note: an aid is something that helps
C stands for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: A remedy with a chill in it, nicknamed after a narcotic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'so-called' marks the definition as a slang name: acid is street slang for LSD.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang usage: LSD is popularly nicknamed after the chemical class of compounds.

clue.text: British union leader in revolt, turning 11 and 8

indicators.note: in signals the union leader goes inside the revolt word

parts.note: a rising is a revolt or uprising

indicators.note: leader means the first letter of union

explanation.surface: A British trade union boss in a rebellion that is going badly for them.
explanation.walkthrough: 11 and 8 are BLACK and BLUE, the colours of a bruise; U goes inside RISING after its R.
explanation.definitionFit: Bruising skin goes the colour of the two linked answers, as with a black eye.

clue.text: See 19 down
Slender and supple, is going to experience desire without love

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside: the two words sit either side of love

parts.note: will expresses future intent, as in he will go
to wish is to feel a desire
love is zero in tennis, written O

explanation.surface: A slim person who is going to long for something but without romance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is taken as 'outside', so WILL and WISH surround O.
explanation.definitionFit: Like a willow tree, which is proverbially lithe, slim and bending.

clue.text: Kind of 25 half-heartedly put in pen

indicators.note: half-heartedly means one of the two letters at the word's heart is dropped

parts.note: to corral animals is to drive them into a pen

explanation.surface: Writing something without enthusiasm.
explanation.walkthrough: 25 is PINK; the heart of CORRAL is RR, and removing half of it leaves CORAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Coral is a shade of pink, named after the marine organism's colour.

clue.text: Like 8 but not 25 in one game, it follows 8 and 25 in another

definitions.text: Like 8 but not 25 in one game
definitions.meaning: in pool the balls include a blue and an eight-ball of this colour, but no pink
in snooker the potting order runs blue, pink, then this final ball

explanation.walkthrough: 8 is BLUE and 25 is PINK; the two games are pool and snooker.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses name a coloured ball: pool's eight-ball and snooker's highest-scoring ball.

clue.text: Spice to eat, spread over old vegetable dish

parts.note: mace is a spice made from nutmeg husks

indicators.note: spread over signals the eating word is stretched around old

parts.note: to dine is to eat

explanation.surface: A recipe instruction: put spice in and eat it over some aged vegetables.
explanation.definitionFit: A macedoine is a mixture of diced vegetables or fruit, served as a salad or garnish.

clue.text: Establishes one's position in store after reorganisation

indicators.note: after reorganisation signals the letters of in store are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone finds their bearings in a shop after it has been rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: To orient oneself is to work out where one stands, especially by compass.

clue.text: It's in Oklahoma, Hawaii … and Nebraska

definitions.text: It's in Oklahoma, Hawaii … and Nebraska

indicators.note: in signals the letters lie inside the words Oklahoma Hawaii

explanation.surface: A geography quiz: a place found in two states and actually in a third.
explanation.walkthrough: The run straddles the end of Oklahoma and the start of Hawaii, and the city is genuinely in Nebraska.
explanation.definitionFit: Omaha is the largest city in the US state of Nebraska.

clue.text: One metre used in variety of basic verse

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

indicators.note: used in signals metre is placed inside the rearranged letters
variety of signals the letters of basic are mixed

explanation.surface: A poetry lesson: one rhythm used across many kinds of simple verse.
explanation.walkthrough: BASIC is rearranged to ABICS, and M goes in after the A.
explanation.definitionFit: Iambics are lines of poetry written in iambic feet.

clue.text: One calmly adapted, accepting husband 8

indicators.note: accepting signals the rearranged letters take in the husband letter
adapted signals the letters of one calmly are rearranged

parts.note: H is the genealogical abbreviation for husband

explanation.surface: A placid person who has adjusted to taking on a husband is feeling down.
explanation.walkthrough: 8 is BLUE in its sense of sad.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling blue means feeling sad or low in spirits, a gloomy state.

clue.text: Religious work faculty outside university's taken up

indicators.note: taken up in a down clue means the letters read from bottom to top
outside signals the faculty word goes around the university letter

parts.note: Arts is a university faculty
U is the abbreviation for university

explanation.surface: A university arts department has picked up a piece of scripture.
explanation.walkthrough: ARTS around U makes ARTUS, which reads upwards as the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A sutra is a Hindu or Buddhist scripture or aphorism.

clue.text: As you're speaking, this goes overhead

indicators.note: speaking signals the words are judged by how they are heard

parts.note: the words are taken as said in speech

explanation.surface: A remark that something passes above as you talk.
explanation.definitionFit: Azure is the clear blue of the sky, and the sky is above us.

clue.text: In evil fashion one's trapped in a French tree

parts.note: un is French for a

indicators.note: trapped in signals one goes inside the tree

parts.note: holly is an evergreen tree
one is I, and the 's is read as is

explanation.surface: Someone wickedly caught in a French tree.
explanation.walkthrough: I sits between the two Ls of HOLLY.
explanation.definitionFit: Unholily means wickedly or sinfully, an adverb of manner.

clue.text: Some work contributing, either way, to greater good

indicators.note: contributing to signals the letters form part of greater good, read forwards or backwards

explanation.surface: Doing some work that adds to the general welfare.
explanation.walkthrough: Forwards it straddles greatER Good; backwards it is the start of GREater.
explanation.definitionFit: The erg is a small unit of work or energy in physics.

clue.text: Choose king that is holding strange club, male counterpart of 5 25?

parts.note: to elect is to choose
R is for Rex, Latin for king

indicators.note: holding signals the that is letters go around the rearranged club

parts.note: i.e. abbreviates id est, that is

indicators.note: strange signals the letters of club are mixed

explanation.surface: A voter picks a king who is carrying an odd weapon.
explanation.walkthrough: 5 25 is SHOCKING PINK; by convention pink is for girls and blue for boys, hence the male counterpart.
explanation.definitionFit: Electric blue is the vivid blue shade conventionally matched to the boys' colour.

clue.text: Settle what's not serious

definitions.meaning: to settle on something, as a bird lands on a branch

explanation.definitionFit: A bird lights on a branch; light reading is undemanding.

clue.text: Revise the tale for 8 (20 or 27), perhaps

indicators.note: revise signals the letters of the tale are reworked

explanation.surface: An editor rewriting a story.
explanation.walkthrough: A Blue is a sportsperson representing Oxford (dark blue) or Cambridge (light blue), hence 20 or 27.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Oxbridge sports competitors are awarded a Blue for representing their university.

clue.text: Article absorbed by players before another game

indicators.note: absorbed by signals the article goes inside the players word

parts.note: the cast are the players in a show
an is the indefinite article
another article, the indefinite a

explanation.surface: An item soaked up by sportsmen before they start a different contest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'before another' supplies a second article to follow the first.
explanation.definitionFit: Canasta is a rummy-style card game from South America.

clue.text: Danish 8, for example, that's said to make one smile

definitions.meaning: Danish Blue is a veined dairy product from Denmark

definitions.text: that's said to make one smile
definitions.meaning: the word photographers ask you to say for a grin

explanation.definitionFit: Danish Blue is a well-known cheese, and photographers say cheese to get a grin.

clue.text: Small dog, by day's end, is 8

parts.note: a mutt is a mongrel dog

indicators.note: end means the last letter of day

explanation.surface: A little hound at the end of the day looks sad.
explanation.walkthrough: 8 is BLUE in its sense of indecent, as in a blue film.
explanation.definitionFit: Blue jokes are rude ones, so blue here means indecent or risqué.

clue.text: Part of explosive mixture shattering steel trap

indicators.note: shattering signals the letters of steel trap are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A blast that wrecks a metal snare.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shattering' fits the explosive surface, but it is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Potassium nitrate is the oxidising ingredient of gunpowder, alongside charcoal and sulphur.

clue.text: Reversed crazy attempt to 25

indicators.note: reversed signals the crazy word is read backwards

parts.note: bats is slang for crazy

explanation.surface: A mad try at something, turned around.
explanation.walkthrough: 25 is PINK, here the verb meaning to pierce lightly, as with a sword in fencing.
explanation.definitionFit: To lunge at something with a blade is to try to pierce it.

clue.text: See 5
Heartless husband pinching ring, a scoundrel

indicators.note: pinching signals the trimmed word grabs the ring between its letters
heartless means the middle letters of husband are removed

parts.note: a ring is round, like the letter O

explanation.surface: A cold-hearted husband grabbing a wedding band is a rogue.
explanation.walkthrough: HUSBAND loses its middle SBA to leave HUND, and O goes in after the H.
explanation.definitionFit: A hound, in old-fashioned usage, is a contemptible or villainous man.

clue.text: Gloomy coastguard's last on rescue vessel

indicators.note: last means the final letter of coastguard

parts.note: Noah's ark rescued the animals from the flood

explanation.surface: A coastguard's final mission aboard a lifeboat on a grim night.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on' puts the D above ARK.
explanation.definitionFit: Dark and gloomy both describe a scene lacking light or cheer.

clue.text: Spent a pound, getting nothing in return

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for a pound sterling, from Latin libra

indicators.note: in return signals the word for nothing is read backwards

parts.note: nil means nothing

explanation.surface: Someone spends a pound and gets nothing back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spent' looks like spending money, matching the pound, but means exhausted.
explanation.definitionFit: Exhausted: all in is an informal phrase for utterly tired out, as spent is.

clue.text: One cuts off electricity at home — our last resort

parts.note: in means at home, as in staying in

indicators.note: resort read as re-sort, sorting the letters of our last again

explanation.surface: Someone cuts the power at home as a final option.
explanation.definitionFit: An insulator is material that blocks the flow of electric current.
